title: TTF/HH ratio leads YAR.OL
hypothesis: R2 | [fertilizer-ag] TTF to Henry Hub ratio 20d z-score > 1.5 leads YAR.OL returns by 2 days (-) as European gas input cost crushes ammonia margins; trade short YAR.OL 5d [finance.ratio.ttf_henryhub -> finance.YAR.OL.log_return]
message: Not supported: TTF/HH ratio z>1 -> short YAR.OL gives r=+0.13 (wrong sign), perm p=0.48, hit rate 0.40 over 43 trades, negative Sharpe-like; no tradeable edge.

trade_idea.entry_rule: finance.ratio.ttf_henryhub rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> short YAR next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.
